full_prompt:
Draw exactly ONE Small Seal glyph U+3D06D.
The supplied chart shows FOUR historical views of the SAME ONE Small Seal character, ordered THX, CCZ, QJZ, DYC. Compare EVERY available witness equally; any slot marked unavailable provides no evidence. Create ONE newly drawn, coherent contemporary sans-serif/Gothic glyph informed by all witnesses, selecting ONE coherent attested construction where variants differ. Never combine incompatible components or replace this with modern Chinese. Trace the real continuous writing-stroke courses using smooth rounded curves and appropriate straight segments; preserve all meaningful branches, legs, bars, counters, crossings, attachments and detachments. Each intentional stroke has the SAME CONSTANT width, approximately 3% of the full canvas, with rounded caps and joins. No brush taper, thick/thin pressure, serifs, texture, ink blobs, doubled outlines or ornamental seal effects. Output exactly ONE complete glyph, black on transparent alpha, centered within the central70% of a square canvas with generous clear margins. No reference copies, four-character layout, labels, text, frames, grid, backdrop or shadows.
STRUCTURAL AND PROPORTIONAL READING:
1. All FOUR specimens available. Entire character is THREE horizontal bars joined by ONE central vertical stem; no additional strokes, dots or counters.
2. Vertical spaces are NEARLY EVEN: upper-to-middle and middle-to-baseline centerline gaps approximately equal, with lower at most10–20% larger. Do NOT push middle bar close to top bar; this character has balanced vertical spacing.
3. Bottom bar longest, upper slightly shorter, middle shortest; lengths approximately bottom1.0,top0.92,middle0.85, consistent with THX/CCZ/DYC. All centered on the same vertical axis.
4. Central vertical begins ON upper bar, crosses middle, and ENDS ON bottom bar, without protrusion beyond either outer bar.
5. Use genuine thin constant-width strokes, bars with straight PARALLEL edges and semicircular caps; do not copy tapered elliptical reference ink.
Important distinguishing proportion: THREE bars with almost EQUAL vertical gaps. Middle horizontal sits near MID-HEIGHT of complete central stem. Bottom a little wider than upper; middle shortest. Perfectly even technical-pen width about3%canvas, no brush pressure.
